mcguire-sponsel.name: McGuire Sponsel
mcguire-sponsel.summary: McGuire Sponsel describes cost segregation using engineering and tax expertise, a site inspection for every study, and a focus on the CPA-client relationship.
mcguire-sponsel.fit: Owners and CPA firms seeking site-inspected studies for acquisitions, new construction, renovations or complex asset records.
mcguire-sponsel.alternative_intro: Compare McGuire Sponsel alternatives using the property investigation and CPA workflow you need. McGuire Sponsel describes a site inspection for every study. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; Duffy + Duffy offers engineering-based analysis; Cost Segregation Guys advertises virtual or in-person studies. Ask each firm to quote the inspection and deliverables for the same building.
mcguire-sponsel.keep: Keep McGuire Sponsel on the shortlist when you need a specialty team working alongside your CPA, especially for a building purchase, construction project, renovation or substantial asset schedule. Its published approach combines engineering and tax expertise.
mcguire-sponsel.boundary: The listed prospect criteria describe typical opportunities, not guaranteed eligibility or tax benefits. Confirm the scope of any related fixed-asset or incentive work rather than assuming it is included in the study.
mcguire-sponsel.fee: Request a property-specific McGuire Sponsel quote. Its official cost segregation page offers a free quote and estimate but does not establish a universal fixed study fee.
mcguire-sponsel.fee_context: A preliminary benefit estimate is different from the professional fee. Specify the property visit, buildings, construction records, improvements, deliverable and CPA coordination before comparing totals.
mcguire-sponsel.filing_answer: The public cost segregation page emphasizes the CPA-client relationship. Ask which schedules and method-change documentation the proposal includes, whether any Form 3115 preparation is separately available, and who signs and files the return.
mcguire-sponsel.price_comparison: Compare a quote for the same property and report scope. AE’s published rate uses square footage; a fixed residential fee, value-based software tier and custom engineering proposal may cover different work.
mcguire-sponsel.vs_intro: Compare McGuire Sponsel alternatives using the property investigation and CPA workflow you need. McGuire Sponsel describes a site inspection for every study. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; Duffy + Duffy offers engineering-based analysis; Cost Segregation Guys advertises virtual or in-person studies. Ask each firm to quote the inspection and deliverables for the same building.
mcguire-sponsel.scenario: Suppose you bought a manufacturing building with a long fixed-asset ledger and several prior renovations. Ask each bidder to explain the site investigation, reconciliation of improvements and report package for your existing CPA.
mcguire-sponsel.decision: Choose the firm whose investigation, asset reconciliation and accountant handoff fit that project. A custom site-inspected study should be evaluated against another matched engineering proposal.
mcguire-sponsel.ae_question: What property investigation, component schedules, support and preparer handoff does AE include, and which implementation tasks require separate scope?
questions: Does the fee include a site inspection for every building in this engagement?
How will existing asset records and renovation costs be reconciled?
Which schedules, draft findings and CPA responses are delivered?
Are method-change preparation, return work or related incentive projects separately priced?
cost_rows: Define each building, inspection and supporting cost record.
Specify existing schedules and renovation review.
Confirm draft findings, final schedules and question handling.
Separately assign forms, return implementation and other specialty projects.

duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.name: Duffy + Duffy Cost Segregation
sources: Duffy + Duffy CPA services and quotes
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.summary: Duffy + Duffy describes engineering-based cost segregation involving CPAs, construction engineers and estimators, including work on commercial and LEED-certified buildings.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.fit: Commercial property owners seeking engineering-based analysis and a specialty report for their existing accountant.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.alternative_intro: Compare Duffy + Duffy Cost Segregation alternatives around the commercial building and records involved. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; McGuire Sponsel describes a site-inspected engineering approach; Cost Segregation Guys offers virtual or in-person workflows. Compare component investigation, final schedules and CPA support for equivalent work.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.keep: Keep Duffy + Duffy on your shortlist for an engineering-based commercial study, including a new or existing building or a LEED-certified project. Its website describes a team with accounting, engineering and estimating experience.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.boundary: Do not treat a commercial engineering proposal as interchangeable with a residential self-serve report. Confirm property eligibility, investigation, accountant questions and any related energy or construction analysis.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.fee: Duffy + Duffy invites owners to request a no-cost analysis and a fee quote. The official homepage and CPA page reviewed do not publish a universal fixed study fee.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.fee_context: Request a written quote for the exact building and study scope. Separate the preliminary estimate of potential tax deferrals from the fee for investigation, analysis, schedules and follow-up.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.filing_answer: Ask who reviews the report with your CPA, what depreciation schedules are supplied, and whether method-change documentation, Form 3115 preparation or return work is part of a separate engagement. The reviewed pages do not establish those inclusions.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.price_comparison: Compare a quote for the same property and report scope. AE’s published rate uses square footage; a fixed residential fee, value-based software tier and custom engineering proposal may cover different work.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.vs_intro: Compare Duffy + Duffy Cost Segregation alternatives around the commercial building and records involved. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; McGuire Sponsel describes a site-inspected engineering approach; Cost Segregation Guys offers virtual or in-person workflows. Compare component investigation, final schedules and CPA support for equivalent work.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.scenario: Suppose you completed an energy-efficient office building and already have a CPA handling the return. Compare the engineering study, treatment of construction records and any separately scoped energy-related work.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.decision: Keep the provider whose proposal addresses the building’s technical details and your preparer’s required documentation. Compare the study fee and any additional specialty work separately.
duffy-duffy-cost-segregation.ae_question: What property investigation, component schedules, support and preparer handoff does AE include, and which implementation tasks require separate scope?
questions: What inspection and engineering investigation are included for this building?
How are construction records and building components documented?
Who answers my CPA’s questions and supplies the final schedules?
Are energy-related analysis, forms or tax-return services separately contracted?
cost_rows: Define the property, engineering investigation and report package.
Identify plans, invoices, improvements and cost reconciliation.
Clarify energy-related analysis, forms and return work.

basis-cost-segregation.name: BASIS Cost Segregation
basis-cost-segregation.summary: BASIS describes an online residential study prepared with purpose-built software and reviewed by cost segregation engineers. Its base service is remote and does not include a physical site visit.
basis-cost-segregation.fit: Owners of eligible residential rentals who want a published study fee and engineer review of an online intake workflow.
basis-cost-segregation.alternative_intro: Compare BASIS Cost Segregation alternatives after confirming residential eligibility. BASIS publishes a remote, engineer-reviewed study workflow. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; My Cost Segregation separates self-serve and professionally reviewed tiers; Cost Segregation Guys offers virtual or in-person studies. Compare investigation, owner effort and preparer handoff.
basis-cost-segregation.keep: Keep BASIS on the shortlist when your rental fits its residential-only scope and you can supply accurate online property information. It advertises engineer review, a report package and three years of limited report-related support.
basis-cost-segregation.boundary: Its agreement excludes commercial properties and apartment buildings with more than four units from the base study. Direct CPA coordination and delivery are not base inclusions; confirm any separately offered add-on. Report support differs from representation.
basis-cost-segregation.fee: BASIS displays a $1,795 residential base price and a $1,295 promotional price through December 31, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. CST. Confirm the checkout price and eligibility; optional services cost extra.
basis-cost-segregation.fee_context: This is a one-time fee per qualifying residential property. The reviewed pricing page excludes tax-return preparation, Form 3115 preparation, IRS representation and separate prior-year or post-purchase renovation services from the base price. Promotions may change.
basis-cost-segregation.filing_answer: BASIS’s base agreement excludes Form 3115 and tax-return preparation, direct CPA coordination and representation unless separately offered and purchased. The customer normally forwards the report to the preparer; confirm the applicable add-on scope before ordering.
basis-cost-segregation.price_comparison: Compare a quote for the same property and report scope. AE’s published rate uses square footage; a fixed residential fee, value-based software tier and custom engineering proposal may cover different work.
basis-cost-segregation.vs_intro: Compare BASIS Cost Segregation alternatives after confirming residential eligibility. BASIS publishes a remote, engineer-reviewed study workflow. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; My Cost Segregation separates self-serve and professionally reviewed tiers; Cost Segregation Guys offers virtual or in-person studies. Compare investigation, owner effort and preparer handoff.
basis-cost-segregation.scenario: Suppose you own a four-unit rental plus a detached guest house and want a reviewed online report. Confirm eligibility and added review before comparing the base fee with a study proposal covering every structure.
basis-cost-segregation.decision: Select a workflow that accepts the property facts and gives your preparer the required evidence. A residential base fee does not price a commercial or unusually complex assignment.
basis-cost-segregation.ae_question: What property investigation, component schedules, support and preparer handoff does AE include, and which implementation tasks require separate scope?
questions: Does my property, unit count and any detached structure fit the base scope?
What owner-supplied information is reviewed and what investigation is performed?
Does the promotion apply at checkout and what add-ons are required?
Who sends the report to my CPA, and which forms or coordination services are separately available?
cost_rows: Displayed $1,795; promotional $1,295 through December 31, 2026, subject to checkout.
Confirm rental use, unit count and unusual structures.
Separately scope renovations, prior-year work or other available modules.
Base report delivery does not include tax filing or direct CPA coordination.

cost-segregation-guys.name: Cost Segregation Guys
sources: Cost Segregation Guys fees and property questions
cost-segregation-guys.summary: Cost Segregation Guys advertises fully engineered studies with virtual or in-person options, a final report and fixed-asset schedule for the CPA, and audit support.
cost-segregation-guys.fit: Owners comparing virtual and on-site study options across rental and commercial property types.
cost-segregation-guys.alternative_intro: Compare Cost Segregation Guys alternatives by inspection method, component detail and accountant handoff. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; McGuire Sponsel describes a site inspection for every study; My Cost Segregation separates self-serve from professionally reviewed workflows. Ask for the same building and report scope before comparing fees.
cost-segregation-guys.keep: Keep Cost Segregation Guys on the shortlist when you want to discuss virtual or in-person engineering and a report with a fixed-asset schedule for your CPA. Its public materials cover rental and commercial property types.
cost-segregation-guys.boundary: The website’s marketing savings, relative-price and turnaround claims are not independent evidence of your project’s outcome. Confirm the selected study route, current delivery date and audit-support terms in the proposal.
cost-segregation-guys.fee: Request a property-specific Cost Segregation Guys quote. Its FAQ says cost depends on property complexity, size and type, and describes upfront quotes rather than a universal fixed study fee.
cost-segregation-guys.fee_context: Ask the quote to identify the chosen virtual or in-person process, buildings, improvements, report schedules and support. Relative-price advertising does not establish the actual fee or comparable scope for your property.
cost-segregation-guys.filing_answer: The site has Form 3115 information and describes report schedules for the CPA. Confirm who evaluates and prepares any required method-change filing, whether that work is offered separately, and who files the income-tax return.
cost-segregation-guys.price_comparison: Compare a quote for the same property and report scope. AE’s published rate uses square footage; a fixed residential fee, value-based software tier and custom engineering proposal may cover different work.
cost-segregation-guys.vs_intro: Compare Cost Segregation Guys alternatives by inspection method, component detail and accountant handoff. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; McGuire Sponsel describes a site inspection for every study; My Cost Segregation separates self-serve from professionally reviewed workflows. Ask for the same building and report scope before comparing fees.
cost-segregation-guys.scenario: Suppose you have a small hotel with recent improvements and are deciding between virtual and on-site investigation. Ask both firms what evidence each process captures and how the report reconciles to your cost records.
cost-segregation-guys.decision: Choose the study method and support package that fit the records and building. Require a written scope and complete fee rather than choosing from a broad savings or speed claim.
cost-segregation-guys.ae_question: What property investigation, component schedules, support and preparer handoff does AE include, and which implementation tasks require separate scope?
questions: Is the quote for virtual investigation or an on-site visit?
What records, building components and improvements will be reviewed?
What final report, fixed-asset file and CPA responses are supplied?
What does audit support cover and who prices any separate method-change or return work?
cost_rows: Price the actual virtual or in-person process.
List buildings, improvements and required cost documentation.
Confirm schedules, accountant questions and written support terms.
Assign any Form 3115 and income-tax return work separately.

my-cost-segregation.name: My Cost Segregation
sources: My Cost Segregation published tier pricing
my-cost-segregation.summary: My Cost Segregation publishes Self-Serve and professionally reviewed study tiers using property records and dated photos. It describes a tax-director signature on every study, with input and photo checks in reviewed tiers.
my-cost-segregation.fit: Owners comparing value-based self-serve pricing with a separately priced professional review workflow.
my-cost-segregation.alternative_intro: Compare My Cost Segregation alternatives by the purchased review level. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; BASIS offers a remote residential workflow with engineer review; Cost Segregation Guys offers virtual or in-person studies. A Self-Serve starting price does not describe the same investigation or review as every professional study.
my-cost-segregation.keep: Keep My Cost Segregation on the shortlist if its property-value tiers, photo-based intake and selected review process fit your property. Confirm whether your preparer wants professional input and photo review before selecting the tier.
my-cost-segregation.boundary: The pricing page requires a reviewed tier for property valued at $1.5 million or more and a custom scope for larger properties. Confirm property classification, price band, review depth, revision window and delivery timing.
my-cost-segregation.fee: My Cost Segregation lists residential Self-Serve from $497 and Expert Reviewed from $2,500. Commercial Self-Serve starts at $1,497 and Commercial Reviewed at $3,500. Prices scale with property value; larger assignments require a scoped quote.
my-cost-segregation.fee_context: These are starting prices for different tiers. Property at $1.5 million or more requires a reviewed tier. Ask for the exact property-value band, review process, revision terms and any separately priced preparation or extra work.
my-cost-segregation.filing_answer: Ask whether any method-change preparation or return integration is included in the selected tier or separately available. A signed study, a professional review and an audit-support pledge do not by themselves establish who prepares or files tax forms.
my-cost-segregation.price_comparison: Compare a quote for the same property and report scope. AE’s published rate uses square footage; a fixed residential fee, value-based software tier and custom engineering proposal may cover different work.
my-cost-segregation.vs_intro: Compare My Cost Segregation alternatives by the purchased review level. AE Tax Advisors offers standalone studies; BASIS offers a remote residential workflow with engineer review; Cost Segregation Guys offers virtual or in-person studies. A Self-Serve starting price does not describe the same investigation or review as every professional study.
my-cost-segregation.scenario: Suppose your rental is close to the $1.5 million review threshold and your CPA wants verified photographs and input checks. Compare the eligible reviewed tier with other firms’ investigation and support proposals.
my-cost-segregation.decision: Choose the tier and provider with a documented process your preparer can use. Compare the actual price band and human review scope rather than the cheapest advertised starting amount.
my-cost-segregation.ae_question: What property investigation, component schedules, support and preparer handoff does AE include, and which implementation tasks require separate scope?
questions: Which residential or commercial value band applies to my property?
Does this tier include professional checks of inputs and photos?
What delivery and revision terms apply after a complete intake?
What are the audit-support limits, and who handles separately scoped tax forms?
cost_rows: At $1.5 million or more, a reviewed tier and scoped price apply.
Confirm revisions, support limits and any separately offered preparation.
